guard.note: client side, a player or not a LivingEntity -> nothing; monster and hasPendingBackpackAddition -> clear it, add a backpack to an empty chest slot; hasSpawnedJukeboxUpgrade -> the jukebox upgrade tick or play
client side or !hasSpawnedBackpack -> return; else (not converting) clears the spawned backpack's data
NeoForge: the persistentData field, a new compound stored there on the first call (asked as many times as before, so it is created on the same call)
getCompound: the held compound when contains(key, 10) (the key's tag, its type id 10), else a new empty one (nothing stored)
get: the tag held under the key (the read getCompound makes), nothing stored
contains(key, type): getTagType(key) equals type (10 here; 99 not used); the switch asks the same id
getTagType: the held tag's getId(), 0 when absent
getBoolean: false on an empty compound; on the held compound asked exactly as the mod asks it

sophisticatedbackpacks_living_tick_fast_.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the hasPendingBackpackAddition and hasSpawnedJukeboxUpgrade calls of EntityBackpackAdditionHandler.onLivingUpdate (an EntityTickEvent.Post listener on NeoForge 1.21.1; Forge: LivingTickEvent) and the hasSpawnedBackpack call of removeBackpackUuid: the same getPersistentData().getCompound("sophisticatedbackpacks").getBoolean(flag) with one read of the key: getPersistentData() once per question as the mod asks it, nothing under the key or a type id other than 10 -> false (what the new empty compound answered), a compound -> its getBoolean(flag); persistent data of a CompoundTag subclass, or a type id 10 that is no compound -> the mod's own expression. Runtime flag sophisticatedbackpacksLivingTickFastExit (off: the mod's methods). Helper bons.furious.patch.sophisticatedbackpacks_coo49.SbEntityData.
